Name: Lehi
Description: The place of the jawbone, where Samson, bound and delivered to the Philistines, seized a fresh jawbone and struck down a thousand men, and where God split a hollow place so he could drink and live; the spring was called En-hakkore.
BiblicalSignificance: Lehi is where Samson's strength turned a donkey's jawbone into a weapon and a prayer into a spring, and the place kept the name Jawbone ever after.
